answer: Proof of Stake consensus forces AI agents to commit locked capital, extending their temporal horizon for returns to prevent cheap identity flooding. Like water carving a karst landscape, the network creates unique economic channels where an attacker must buy substantial collateral. If an agent attempts to create a Sybil island of fake nodes, it must distribute its stake, diluting its own voting power and rendering the cost of total network subversion prohibitively expensive compared to honest participation.
